preliminary: The face-only trial preceded the final scalar/air batch; its runs are not included in final aggregates.
windowed: A final optimized window run stopped making progress without a logged graphics error and was manually interrupted. Visibility suspension was suspected but not independently verified. No completed report exists; it is excluded.
overlap: A preliminary final-a optimized process started 249 ms before its reference process finished. Both are excluded from final aggregates.
finalMethod: All retained runs are sequential complete native application loops with offscreen presentation, unchanged physics/render detail, and warm-up discarded. No retained run reports device loss or a renderer failure.
